catches: The friend must fund $2,000+ within 60 days of account opening - and keep it in the account 6 months before the bonus can be withdrawn as cash.
IRA accounts are excluded for both referrer and referee.
Referral must be a US resident and brand-new tastytrade customer with no prior accounts.
Max 24 referral bonuses per calendar year.
If the friend browses tastytrade before clicking your link and then returns later, the referral may not be credited - link attribution can break.

steps: Be a tastytrade customer (18+) and get your unique referral link/code: web at my.tastytrade.com > Manage > Summary > View Referral Link; mobile via More > Settings > Referrals.
Share your referral link or code with a friend (US resident, 18+, new tastytrade customer, no prior accounts; IRA accounts are excluded for both parties).
Your friend opens a new tastytrade account using your referral link/code and deposits a minimum of $2,000 within 60 days of account opening.

You receive a $100 bonus credited to your account (friend also receives $100); the bonus is available for trading immediately but cannot be withdrawn as cash until the $2,000 deposit has remained in the friend's account for 6 months.
timing: Bonus credited once the referee meets funding requirements; available for trading immediately, withdrawable as cash after the $2,000 deposit has been in the account for 6 months.
